相对前一天成交额倍数
首次有效发现（基线后，一次性）

scoring.hot_score: sum(decayed volume, turnover, price, volume_growth contributions)
scoring.tie_break: asset_id ascending; full precision; display 2 decimals
scoring.scope: Exact market_v1 policy IDs only. Existing initial +100, search-trending and other rules stay on their existing chain, excluded from pure-market board projection.

idempotency.snapshot: Freeze first valid successful response and mapping per source/slot; no late-slot awards or catch-up.
idempotency.contribution: One positive contribution per asset/rule/slot; repeated valid later slots may contribute again. Highest tier only.
idempotency.publisher: #3006 assigns event_key and first created_at; persist and retry original values and decay parameters. No per-query awards.
idempotency.discovery: One award per verified asset/rule version after baseline; preserve first_seen_at. baseline/coverage_added/pending never award.

quality: Only finite valid USD market values; require unique verified asset_id before publishing scores.
Validate source and collected/request times; no future/over-15m source timestamps. Failed or missing coverage is not zero.
Rolling 24h volume snapshots are not 5m/1h volume; compare with causal same-source/currency/coverage baseline near t-24h.
History gaps skip only volume_growth contribution; warming requires a valid volume baseline and saved score baseline.
Price magnitude generates attention points for both directions; preserve up/down and do not infer buy/sell.
Queries never execute graph actions. Changes to tiers require a new rule version, no reinterpretation of frozen events.
Redis current projections older than 120 seconds are excluded; no refresh success is inferred from card definitions.

check: Coverage gaps, duplicate awards and repeated appearances
calibration.execution: Versioned review against real observations; no autonomous production parameter mutation or scheduled monitor installed.
